rows.purpose: Once-per-frame game-thread tick (the photo-mode system's pre-update).
rows.evidence: Live: 235 calls in 2 s on the same thread as the camera commit; mirror prototype ran 1772 frames from it with zero faults.

rows.purpose: Create a game object from a loaded actor asset at a transform.
rows.evidence: Called by the photo-mode doppelganger spawn handler; live call returned an object with 16 components for the Miles actor.

rows.purpose: Activate freshly created objects so their components run and render.
rows.evidence: Live: object flags went 0x20A to 0x220B and the puppet rendered afterwards.

rows.purpose: Turn an object handle into a live object pointer, or null once it is gone.
rows.evidence: Live: resolved the puppet, and returned null one second after destroy.

rows.purpose: Move an actor to a new world transform.
rows.evidence: Live: puppet followed the hero for 1772 frames.

rows.purpose: Queue an object for the engine's deferred destroy.
rows.evidence: Live: puppet disappeared and its handle resolved to null; game stayed stable.

rows.purpose: Check that an actor asset is loaded before spawning from it.
rows.evidence: Live: returned the loaded Miles actor asset; returned null for assets that are not loaded.

rows.purpose: The look a RandomLook component has chosen: its list of body groups (mask, hood, body).
rows.evidence: Documented by norfmare's first-person mod for this build; live call on hero and double returned the same four groups.

rows.purpose: The actor that carries an object's visible suit model.
rows.evidence: Documented by norfmare's first-person mod; live call returned a separate visible actor for hero and double.

rows.purpose: Show a look's body groups on an actor.
rows.evidence: Live: the double had no head in the Homemade Suit until this call showed its mask.

rows.purpose: Request a lighting mode (time of day and weather) by index 0-6; the game blends to it in place.
rows.evidence: Called by SetLightingModeAction's execute (0xDC3770) with the lighting system + 0xE10D0 and the index of the mode's hash in its table. Live: index 2 to 4 changed the city's lighting within a second, no loading screen, game kept running.

rows.purpose: Ask the actor asset manager for an actor asset by id, starting a background load when it is not in memory; actor_asset_lookup finds it once loaded.
rows.evidence: Decompiled: hashes nothing itself, maps aliases, then calls the base asset manager's request (0x1B30DD0), which creates an entry and starts the load when the archive holds the asset. Live: the pistol thug actor (8b8478c2dfa1b694), not loaded on this PC, was loadable 199 ms after the request and spawned and rendered with its pistol.

rows.purpose: The pause list (PopupSystemMenuUI) acting on a chosen item; the second argument is the item's id as stored in the menu config (0 Resume, 1 Restart Last Checkpoint, 3 Exit Danger Room, 4 Photo Mode, 5 Settings, 6 Quit). Ids above 0x60 fall through and do nothing.
rows.evidence: Decompiled switch matches the menu config's ids; live: choosing added items with ids 0x44 and 0x200 reached it with those values and the menu kept working.

rows.purpose: Localised text for a text tag's hash; returns the fallback, or INVALID, when the tag is unknown.
rows.evidence: Decompiled; the pause map and the menu call it with label hashes. Live: menu items with new tags showed INVALID, and returning our own text from a hook showed it.

rows.purpose: The engine's string hash (second argument 0xEDB88320), used for text tags.
rows.evidence: Live: hashing PAUSE_OPTION_RESUME gave 0x72BB280D, the hash stored with that menu label.

rows.purpose: ActorWarpAction's warp: sends a warp event to an object (the hero handles it) for a transform, falling back to setting the transform. First argument is the action: +8 must point at an object (used for its handle); +0x60 to +0x65 are settings, zero is fine.
rows.evidence: Decompiled. Live: warping the standing hero 57 m with a zeroed action whose +8 is the hero put him there and he stayed; a perched hero drifts back towards his perch.
